parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this border router.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Indicates the status of this border router.

parameters.name: BorderAgentID
parameters.description: Globally unique ID generated by the Thread Border Router.

parameters.name: MLEReference
parameters.description: Define the Thread network to which it belongs.

parameters.name: RoutingRef
parameters.description: Define the routing and forwarding configuration of the BorderRouter, in order to access the Thread Network it manages. This is the way to manage ::/64 prefix used for global addressing of the mesh network (see Thread Specification {{bibref|ThreadIPv6Addressing}} "IPv6 Address Configuration").

object.description: The BorderRouter is capable of forwarding between a Thread Network and a non-Thread Network. Each BorderRouter entry is associated with a particular Thread Network (or MLE) instance via the {{param|MLEReference}} parameter.
